summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Buyer Onboarding & Matching Engine features - Iteration 6. All 14 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests verified: buyer registration redirects to onboarding, onboarding form with strategic/financial types, profile_complete logic, affinity badges (Alta/Media/Baja afinidad) in Spanish, 'Ordenar por relevancia' sort only for complete profiles, and profile-incomplete-block on DealPage.

backend: POST /api/auth/register - New buyer registration returns access_token and user with buyer_profile
PUT /api/users/me/buyer-profile - Complete update (type, operation_types, taxonomy_categories, ticket_min, revenue_range_min, ebitda_range_min) sets profile_complete=true
PUT /api/users/me/buyer-profile - Financial subtypes (financial_pe, financial_fo, financial_vc, financial_holding) work correctly
GET /api/matching/deals - Returns profile_complete=false for incomplete profile
GET /api/matching/deals - Returns deals with affinity field (high/medium/low) for complete profile
GET /api/matching/deals - Returns affinity_label in Spanish (Alta afinidad, Afinidad media, Baja afinidad)
GET /api/deals/{deal_id}/activation-preview - Returns compatible_buyers stats (high, medium, low, total)
frontend: Register page loads with role selection (Comprador, Vendedor, Advisor)
Buyer registration redirects to /buyer/onboarding when profile incomplete
BuyerOnboarding page shows progress indicator (Tipo, Operación, Sectores, Financieros)
BuyerOnboarding - Strategic/Financial buyer type selection works
BuyerOnboarding - Financial subtypes (PE, VC, Family Office, Holding) shown when Financial selected
BuyerOnboarding - Operation types (Compra total, Compra parcial, Fusión) selection works
BuyerOnboarding - Taxonomy categories loaded from API and selectable
BuyerOnboarding - Financial criteria inputs (ticket_min, revenue_min, ebitda_min) work
BuyerOnboarding - Geography selection works
BuyerOnboarding - Save profile redirects to /buyer/dashboard
BuyerDashboard - Shows 'Deals Recomendados' section with affinity badges
BuyerDashboard - Affinity badges show 'ALTA AFINIDAD' (green) and 'AFINIDAD MEDIA' (yellow)
BuyerDashboard - NO numeric scores shown (only qualitative labels)
Marketplace - Anonymous users do NOT see 'Ordenar por relevancia' option
Marketplace - Anonymous users do NOT see affinity badges
Marketplace - Logged-in buyers with complete profile see 'Ordenar por relevancia' option
Marketplace - Logged-in buyers with complete profile see affinity badges on deal cards
Marketplace - Affinity badges in Spanish: 'Alta afinidad', 'Afinidad media'
DealPage - Buyer with incomplete profile sees 'Perfil incompleto' block after NDA
DealPage - 'Perfil incompleto' block shows 'Completar perfil' button
DealPage - Interest CTA hidden for incomplete profile buyers

context_for_next_testing_agent: All buyer onboarding and matching engine features are working correctly. Key verified features: 1) New buyer registration redirects to /buyer/onboarding, 2) Buyer profile form captures type (strategic/financial with subtypes), operation_types, taxonomy_categories, financial criteria, geography, 3) profile_complete=true only when all required fields filled, 4) Matching API returns affinity labels (high/medium/low) with Spanish display labels (Alta afinidad, Afinidad media, Baja afinidad), 5) NO numeric scores exposed to frontend, 6) 'Ordenar por relevancia' sort only visible for logged-in buyers with complete profile, 7) DealPage shows 'Perfil incompleto' block for buyers without complete profile after NDA signed.
